video.huTitle: Magyar népmesék: A szegény ember szőlője

summary.hu: Egy szegény embernek három fia van és egy szőlője.
summary.en: A poor man has three sons and a vineyard.
summary.ro: Un om sărac are trei fii și o vie.

summary.hu: Valaki minden éjjel tönkreteszi a szőlőt. A fiúk vigyáznak rá.
summary.en: Someone ruins the vineyard every night. The sons guard it.
summary.ro: Cineva strică via în fiecare noapte. Fiii o păzesc.

summary.hu: Csak a legkisebb fiú tudja megvédeni.
summary.en: Only the youngest son can protect it.
summary.ro: Doar fiul cel mic reușește s-o apere.

summary.en: He gave food to a frog.
summary.ro: El i-a dat mâncare unei broaște.

summary.hu: A béka hálából három varázslovat ad neki.
summary.en: To thank him, the frog gives him three magic horses.
summary.ro: Drept mulțumire, broasca îi dă trei cai fermecați.

summary.hu: A lovakkal a fiú elnyeri a királylány kezét.
summary.en: With the horses the boy wins the princess's hand.
summary.ro: Cu caii, băiatul câștigă mâna prințesei.

questions.qEn: What does the poor man have?

questions.q: Kinek ad ételt a legkisebb fiú?
questions.qEn: Who does the youngest son give food to?
What does he get from the frog?
